checks.name: Public Host serves a reachable App business interface
Browser create is visible through actual MCP snapshot
Browser edit persists
Reload retains data
Untrusted text never executes
Publishing creates exactly the invited app-local notifications
Browser votes are committed
Withdrawal is distinct from voting no
Confirmation uses selected slot
Reopening invalidates prior confirmation
Slot replacement preserves old record but has no inherited votes
Unchanged slot keeps its prior vote
Stale finalize after independent reply changes no business records
Reload and independent MCP query show exactly one current meeting
Stale dialog displays failure without false success
Refresh displays independent MCP change
Lost-response retry has one cancellation effect
Participant UI has no organizer controls
Incomplete response reports validation error
Refresh observes independent scenario event
Direct browser request cannot access management snapshots
Backend rejects organizer operation even when participant crafts request
Timezone selector changes visible local dates
Notifications view is usable
Notification read commits
Mobile viewport has no document overflow
No browser JavaScript errors
